name: hud_sensor_tracker_command_toggle_objective_panel
description: HudSensorTracker::Command_ToggleObjectivePanel plays the objective review click and toggles the objective panel through SetObjectivePanelVisible based on whether objectiveUiMode is currently 2. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudSensorTracker objective-command cluster because this wrapper depends on member-call context and the SetObjectivePanelVisible source cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x418730 validates the objectiveReviewSfx zSndSample::PlayA3DSimple call and the objectiveUiMode != 2 toggle argument passed into HudSensorTracker::SetObjectivePanelVisible.
The native smoke verifies command-show from a non-panel UI mode and command-hide from objective panel mode using the same localized panel fixture that verifies SetObjectivePanelVisible.
